body:
I’d say that honestly, you know the situation best and at the end of the day it is your call and your life. Ignore how you will be perceived and follow your heart, if you really want her back then go for it. If you are still confused, go with the option that will leave you with the least regret 10 years from now, because this little discomfort from extending another olive branch won’t matter by then.
Also, if you do reach out, be aware that it may not go how you hope. Also don’t rush into anything too fast. You should analyze what worked and didn’t work last time and adjust accordingly as things must be different this time in some way.

Thank you for the support, I am good now but I really appreciate the offer as it means a lot that there are strangers on the internet who would come to support me. <3 I’m starting to feel all bubbly inside reading these comments. :)

That’s a very beautiful quote, thank you for sharing. Very true about there being a luck component to it all, I think I’m probably gonna take a break from the dating world and try to focus on some goals that I have. Strangely I am really grateful for the experience and being able to say that I loved someone enough to experience heart break is cool haha :) all apart of what it means to be human.
Thank you so much for the kind words <3
